title: Set Matrix Zeroes
summary: For every zero present in the original matrix, set its entire row and column to zero.

contractDetails.constraints: 1–200 rows and columns. Each entry is a signed 32-bit integer.
contractDetails.callable: `setZeroes` mutates the supplied matrix and returns no value outside R. The runner reads the changed matrix. R returns the changed list of rows.

statement: For every zero present in the original matrix, set its entire row and column to zero. Change the matrix in place and show the final contents.

examples.explanation: Only the original zero triggers clearing.
With no zero present, every value stays the same.

constraints: 1–200 rows and columns. Each entry is a signed 32-bit integer.
hints: Conceptual: New zeros must not trigger additional rows or columns.
Directional: The first row and column can hold markers for the interior.
Implementation: Save whether the first row and column originally contain zeros. Mark and clear the interior before clearing those two borders.
complexityAnalysis: O(mn) time and O(1) extra space in a mutable matrix representation.
